comment: Menu art drawn as glyphs in the inventory TITLE. A title glyph renders behind the items and
in front of the container background, which is exactly the layer a menu backdrop needs.
U+E901  shop_gui.png. Canvas 256x256; the art occupies x 25..230, y 0..221 (206x222).
222 is the exact height of a 6-row chest window, so at height:256 (scale 1:1) the art
covers the whole window. ascent:13 puts its top row at the window's top edge: the title
baseline sits at y=13 (drawn at y=6, vanilla ascent 7), and a glyph's top row lands at
